trace.question: How many patients with a normal Ig A level came to the hospital after 1990/1/1?
trace.evidence: normal Ig A level refers to IGA > 80 AND IGA < 500; came to the hospital after 1990/1/1 refers to YEAR(`First Date`) > = 1990;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGA > 80
  AND l.IGA < 500
  AND p.`First Date` >= '1990-01-01'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGA > 80
  AND l.IGA < 500
  AND p.`First Date` >= '1990-01-01'
trace.answer: There were 140 patients with a normal IgA level who came to the hospital after January 1, 1990.
